data.name: Heavens Gate
data.detailed_description:
Heavens Gate is a fast, simple brain-training adventure where learning becomes the battle.

Three friends are pulled into a strange spiritual trial and must fight through different realms on the road to Heavens Gate. Their enemy is the devil, and every battle brings them closer to the final question: can they survive long enough to defeat evil and have their sins forgiven?

This is not just a button-mashing game. To attack, survive, and progress, players answer math problems or language-learning questions in a flashcard-style format. Every correct answer helps you fight back. Every mistake brings danger closer.

Practice memory, math, vocabulary, grammar, and language skills in a way that feels more active than normal studying. It is built around repetition, pressure, characters, enemies, realms, achievements, and rewards.

Play story mode and battle toward Heavens Gate, test yourself in endless mode, or compete with another player in multiplayer. Heavens Gate is for students, language learners, teachers, parents, and anyone who wants a game that actually uses your brain.

Can you answer fast enough? Can you survive the devil's trial? Can you make it to Heavens Gate?
